desc: The KRISS USA Vector SDP G3 is a semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm, 45 ACP and 9mm. Models in this line feature a 5.5" barrel, 33, 10, 30 and 40 round capacity options, flat dark earth and black polymer grips and low profile flip up sights. The line is offered in 2-tone, arctic delta camo and woodland delta camo finishes. Additional features include picatinny end rail and pivoting, single stage trigger.
